path = Path('src/models/user.py')
module = ast.parse(path.read_text())
user = next(node for node in module.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == 'User')
doc = ast.get_docstring(user) or ''
required = [
    'Attributes:',
    'Methods:',
    'Example:',
    'id:',
    'email:',
    'name:',
    'active:',
    'item_ids:',
    'can_login:',
    'owns_item:',
    'User(',
]
missing = [item for item in required if item not in doc]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f'Missing docstring content: {missing}')
print('Static docstring structure check passed')
PY"
